title: Sleep and Learning
introduction: یک متن آموزشی کوتاه درباره عادت‌های سالم یادگیری؛ واژه‌های کلیدی را بعد از خواندن مرور کن.
paragraphs: Learning a language takes time and attention. Many students study for long hours, but they sometimes forget that rest is important too.
During sleep, the brain works with information from the day. A good night’s sleep can help you focus, remember new words, and feel ready to learn.
You do not need to study late every night. Try to make a simple routine: review a few words, prepare your books, and go to bed at a regular time.
Short study sessions with enough rest are often easier to continue than very long sessions. A healthy routine helps you learn step by step.
